integrity: The all-n statement is supported by a symbolic proof. The bounded computational checks are regression tests, not an infinite proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The reduced singular locus over C is classified; the singular scheme and arbitrary characteristic are not. The rank-one transverse chart applies only at non-fixed points; fixed charts are affine K_n edge semigroup cones. Unindexed equivalent CFN claw-model work remains a literature risk; one relevant journal article was abstract-only.
title: Singular-curve arrangement and jumping local class groups of cycle cut varieties
